name: dashboard_auth_prefix_normalise_public_url
notes: public_url normaliser (dashboard_auth_prefix.c vs LIVE prefix.py). Inputs avoid three documented cosmetic divergences outside this class: (1) LIVE strips BOTH ends before the reject-char scan while the port only lstrips (trailing-space inputs diverge); (2) urlparse lowercases the scheme so HTTP:// passes LIVE but not the port; (3) LIVE requires a non-empty netloc so https:///path is rejected by LIVE but accepted by the port.
